Login fails after password reset

After resetting the password the user is sent back to /login and sees “Session expired”. Reported by support, see ticket 4812.

Steps

  1. Open the reset link from the email.

  2. Set a new password with at least 12 characters.

  3. Submit the form and wait for the redirect.

Expected: the user is logged in. Actual: nothing happens. Actual: a 401 from /api/session.

Release checklist

  • Bump the version in package.json

  • Update the changelog

  • Tag the release as v1.4.3

  • Announce in the team channel

  • Web app

    • Issue list

  • API

  • Mobile, via the shared client
